# LoopDesk Discount Function build artifact directory

`index.wasm` is generated by Shopify CLI's supported JavaScript Function/Javy build pipeline and is intentionally ignored by git.

For Shopify releases, `shopify app deploy` runs the extension `[extensions.build].command` from `shopify.extension.toml` and expects the artifact at `dist/index.wasm`. Do not invoke a nested Shopify CLI deploy or function build from the extension build step; doing so nests Shopify CLI inside its own function build and can hang releases.

If an older local toolchain emits `dist/function.wasm`, the extension build script copies that real artifact to `dist/index.wasm` for the current deploy contract. The build must produce a real Shopify Function-compatible WASM artifact; no placeholder or fallback WASM should be committed.
